inflight_experience_food_beverage: Anything about food or drinks during the flight (quality, taste, temperature, freshness, quantity, variety, special meals, drink service). PRIORITY: HIGH if food poisoning, severe allergy negligence, or foreign objects in food. MEDIUM if pre-ordered/paid meal is missing or food is completely inedible. LOW for taste preference, temperature, or minor service complaints.
inflight_experience_seats_comfort: Seat comfort on board (legroom, recline, seat width, cushioning, ability to sleep/rest, personal space, seat layout). PRIORITY: HIGH if seat is broken/unsafe, causing injury, or soaking wet. MEDIUM if features (recline/power) broken on long-haul flights. LOW for general comfort complaints, tight legroom, or aesthetic wear and tear.
inflight_experience_entertainment: In-flight entertainment and connectivity (screens, movies/TV/music, games, Wi-Fi/internet, system usability, system not working). PRIORITY: HIGH is rarely used unless exposed wiring/safety issue. MEDIUM if Wi-Fi/screens not working on long-haul flights (paid service failure). LOW for poor movie selection, slow interface, or issues on short flights.
inflight_experience_cabin_service: Cabin crew and service during the flight (friendliness, politeness, professionalism, responsiveness, language skills, service speed/attentiveness). PRIORITY: HIGH for harassment, discrimination, aggression, or refusal to assist in medical emergency. MEDIUM for rude behavior, ignoring call lights, or significantly slow service. LOW for lack of smiles, language barriers, or minor slowness.
inflight_experience_cleanliness: Cleanliness inside the aircraft (seats, tray tables, toilets, floors, smell, general hygiene, trash not collected, dirty cabin). PRIORITY: HIGH for biohazards (blood, vomit), insect infestation, or unusable toilets on long flights. MEDIUM for trash left by previous passenger, dirty tray tables, or bad odors. LOW for general wear, water spots, or untidiness.
checkin_process: Check-in experience at the airport or online (desks, kiosks, queues, waiting time, staff at check-in, technical issues with check-in). PRIORITY: HIGH if technical error prevents check-in entirely or risks missing the flight. MEDIUM for excessive queues (>45 mins), rude staff, or system glitches causing stress. LOW for minor waits, kiosk UI confusion, or aesthetic complaints.
boarding_process: Boarding at the gate (announcements, boarding order, priority boarding, crowd management, waiting at the gate, confusion during boarding). PRIORITY: HIGH if denied boarding error, gate change without notice causing missed flight, or dangerous overcrowding. MEDIUM for chaotic process, confusion, or lack of priority enforcement. LOW for minor delays or unclear announcements.
baggage_lost: Lost or missing baggage (bags not arriving, bags delayed to another flight, bags sent to the wrong airport or never found). PRIORITY: HIGH if bag is currently missing/status unknown, or contains medical/essential items. MEDIUM if bag was delayed but has been located/delivered. LOW if feedback is retrospective (bag was lost months ago, now resolved).
baggage_damaged: Damaged baggage (broken wheels, torn bags, damaged contents, visible damage after arrival). PRIORITY: HIGH if contents are destroyed or bag is completely unusable/open. MEDIUM for broken wheels/handles requiring compensation. LOW for scratches, minor dents, or wear and tear.
booking_and_ticketing: Booking and ticket management (website/app issues, payment problems, ticket changes, rebooking, schedule changes, errors during purchase, confirmation issues). PRIORITY: HIGH if payment taken but no ticket issued, or technical error prevents booking urgent travel. MEDIUM for inability to change flight, website crashes, or hidden errors. LOW for confusing UI, minor app glitches, or typo corrections.
customer_support: Any interaction with customer support (call center, email, chat, social media), including response time, politeness, clarity, helpfulness, and resolution quality. PRIORITY: HIGH if support refuses valid refund, hangs up, or issue remains unresolved >14 days. MEDIUM for long hold times, unhelpful copy-paste responses, or lack of follow-up. LOW for tone of voice or general feedback on process.
pricing_and_loyalty: Ticket prices, extra fees, value for money, and loyalty/miles (fare levels, hidden charges, surcharges, fairness of price, miles/points, status, benefits). PRIORITY: HIGH if charged incorrectly/double charged or status benefits denied without reason. MEDIUM for hidden fees, fairness of price, or missing miles. LOW for general complaints about high prices or program rules.
